genome.object: an open gray and black laptop
genome.name: Lapgremlin
genome.lore: It hatched from an unfinished software update and now demands cookies.

genome.object: a black smartphone displaying an article
genome.name: Phonegre
genome.lore: It hatched from an unread article and now demands bedtime scrolling.

genome.object: a translucent orange-red water bottle with a black screw cap
genome.name: Hydr imp
genome.lore: It escaped a hiking pack and now demands a sip break every twelve steps.

genome.object: a bunch of ripe yellow bananas
genome.name: Bananogre
genome.lore: A fruit bowl grew this friendly ogre after someone wished for a bigger bunch.

genome.name: Apple Imp
genome.lore: It escaped the fruit bowl after being told it was too sweet to cause trouble.

genome.object: a yellow rubber duck with an orange beak
genome.name: Quacken
genome.lore: It hatched from a bubble bath and immediately demanded a bigger tub.

genome.object: white over-ear wired headphones with dark gray cushions
genome.name: Headphonimp
genome.lore: It hatched when a tangled headphone cable finally heard its favorite song.

genome.object: a sealed cup of creamy bubble tea with black tapioca pearls and a striped straw
genome.name: Bobogre
genome.lore: A forgotten tapioca pearl wished really hard to become the whole drink.

genome.object: a red and black high-top sneaker with a white sole
genome.name: Solegre
genome.lore: It escaped a shoebox after learning to tie its own battle knots.

genome.object: a red fly agaric mushroom with pale speckles and a cream stem
genome.name: Shroomlin
genome.lore: It sprouted when a garden gnome dropped its polka-dot umbrella.

genome.name: Pizzimp
genome.lore: It escaped the oven after discovering its crust had supernatural crunch.

genome.object: a silver and black wired computer mouse
genome.name: Mouseferatu
genome.lore: One midnight double-click summoned this tiny desktop vampire.

genome.object: a black aluminum drink can with a silver pull-tab top
genome.name: Cangremlin
genome.lore: It woke up when someone pulled its tab before its morning fizz.

genome.object: a white ceramic mug filled with milky coffee
genome.name: Mugremlin
genome.lore: It woke up when someone stirred their coffee counterclockwise.

genome.object: a tall ribbed green cactus in a botanical illustration
genome.name: Cactogre
genome.lore: It escaped a botanical textbook to demand hugs with a very generous safety distance.
